_description: The model version identifier (IP-unified-architecture §10). MAJOR = structural change (a law, a divisor set, H). MINOR = refit (coefficients move, structure does not). Deliberately OUTSIDE model-parameters.json: a version label must not change the model's content identity (CONSTANTS_HASH). Seeded at v10.0 continuing the repo's existing v9/v10 tag lineage (owner decision); MAJOR/MINOR bumps proceed from here under this scheme. Content identity is carried separately by CONSTANTS_HASH (model parameters) and COEFFICIENTS_HASH (the fit) in packages/physics/src/constants/.
_v16_1Note: v16.0 → v16.1 (2026-10, plan 06 I3): a MINOR — the Sun planetary completion's long-period rows re-derived, structure of the completion unchanged. (1) The Earth–Mars–Jupiter long inequality 4λ_E − 8λ_Ma + 3λ_J rides the planets' eccentricity vectors of date in D'Alembert form (a sum over Earth, Mars and Jupiter of e_X(t)·[a cos(θ + ϖ_X(t)) + b sin(θ + ϖ_X(t))], the embedded 1-kyr grid from the banked series), derived on the model's own N-body over ±20,000 yr — the constant row held inside ±3000 yr and drifted 3.7″ beyond. (2) The completion's carriers are the model's own banked J2000 sidereal mean motions (the planet records' rounded periods minus p₀ sat 4.1″/yr off for Venus). (3) The lunar equation's argument is the framework's Moon elongation of date (ṅ included). (4) The Venus–Earth row (fifth order, resonant — a cluster) stays constant, re-derived over ±3100 yr on the new carriers. Against DE441 in the fixed J2000 frame the per-millennium scatter at ±9000 yr fell from 4.1–4.7″ to 2.3–3.6″; against Horizons the modern window reads 0.83 ± 0.78″ (was 0.74 ± 0.94), the ancient millennia 4.16/3.85/2.89″ sd (was 4.44/3.81/2.82).
_v16Note: v15.0 → v16.0 (2026-09, owner: 'all calculations should match what we measure in the scene'): a structural MAJOR — three year-length laws restated so the scene's measured years reproduce them (the scene-sampled gate tools/verify/scene-year-lengths.js, 30 ms). (1) The tropical year of date is built on the equinox's GENERAL-PRECESSION rate (the broken angle through the node of the ecliptic of date — the literature's p_A, `generalPrecessionLonDeg`), not the projected J2000 longitude rate: equal at J2000, apart with the square of the ecliptic's tilt (0.05 s at ±4 kyr, ~1 s beyond 100 kyr; 5.9″ of Sun at −3000). (2) The year relations are rate-form with the sampler's Julian-year unit named — the precession period had been counted in tropical years by the pair's beat and realised per Julian year by the frame (26 ms of tropical year; periods are now quoted in Julian years, the J2000 reading 25,771.4 unchanged). (3) The anomalistic year and Earth's apsidal period ride the ONE movement's own apsidal line (the scene's perihelion), no longer the planet chain's secular tangent (3.3 s at 0 AD, 395 s at +25 kyr). With it the D6 λ̇ channel is re-banked as the least-squares quadratic slope of the run's unwrapped L over 10 kyr (the 2-kyr boxcar of step rates carried 0.1–0.3 s of node noise, +18…28″ of Sun by 6500 against DE441). Sun vs Horizons 3.66 → 2.57″ mean; against DE441 in the fixed J2000 frame rms 18.9 → 5.4″ over ±9000 yr; cardinal instants −1.49 → −1.04 min.
_v15Note: v14.0 → v15.0 (2026-09, plan 06 §9 item 10): a structural MAJOR — a new term family on the precession. THE PRECESSION OF DATE: the spin integration's precession constant is the secular (composed) law times two factors of date, both exactly 1 at J2000 — the solar torque's (1 − e²)^(−3/2) at the eccentricity OF DATE (the solar-share formula held e at J2000) and J₂(t)/J₂₀, the oblateness of date from the GIA channel (ψ̇ ∝ the dynamical ellipticity; scaled on the observed dJ₂/dt, the new input deepTime.j2RateJ2000PerYr, Cox & Chao 2002). Measured, theory against theory: the equinox of date against Vondrák et al. (2011) −27″ → −7″ at −3000 (≤ 0.3″ inside −500…+2500); the Sun against Horizons 9.4 → 3.7″ mean over ±3000 yr; the cardinal instants −3.8 → −1.5 min; the obliquity against La2004 over the last million years 80 → 14″ rms. Unchanged: the secular composed law and its deep-time gates, the unit H(t), the era clock, the tidal chain, the planet chains, the day, the polar moment, the eccentricity. The Sun's longitude of date follows the equinox and the Moon's arguments do not, so ancient eclipse geometry moves by the equinox correction (~8 km of umbra track at −135; the eclipse audit unchanged at its rounding). Also in this identity: the lunar-alignment campaign re-recorded (it had been stale since the deep-eccentricity slope anchor — its inputs block now lists what it runs on).
_v14Note: v13.0 → v14.0 (2026-09, plan 06 Phases 1–2 + D7): a structural MAJOR. (1) The climate formula's L1 is no longer a divisor set: 25 lines derived from the engine's own Earth z/ζ modes and p (relative amplitude ≥ 0.1) plus the g₂−g₅ fundamental and its two climate-internal harmonics, one home (data/l1-physical-lines.json); the 33-integer comb and the L2 layer retire (T1). (2) A new term family: α(t) is the LAGGED viscoelastic response of the polar moment to that ice history, α = α₀ − k·[L1 − ⟨L1⟩_τ], k derived at runtime from the Cox–Chao rate, τ = 6 kyr MEASURED by the historical ΔT record (D7) — the instantaneous α ∝ L1 law and its stored scale retire. (3) The Core-mantle swing ships as the two-impulse episode only; its drive tone retires at amplitude 0. (4) The ΔT stack refit and the whole historical gate suite re-baselined (lunar 1213 s / 119 of 267, solar 665 s / 43 of 89); the ΔT-stack lattice labels measured at chance level (T5) and stated in years. The tidal chain, the planet chains, the Moon chain and the cardinal clock are unchanged.
_v13Note: v12.0 → v13.0: the model restatement (two engines + two expansions). A claims-layer MAJOR: the 8H lattice retires as planetary-orbit dynamics (typed descriptors remain — doc 109 §9); the Fibonacci structural claims retire (exact balance, the Saturn e-prediction, Config-#7 uniqueness, the node integers — doc 10 Status; the ~98% observation survives); Law 6 restated as the Earth-frame beat identity at J2000; the falsification criterion replaced by the three-legger (CLAUDE.md §Verification); ESSRT restated as the two-tier expansion (doc 99). The physics numbers are unchanged — every Earth-family gate bit-identical (browser tier 157/157).
_v11Note: v10.0 → v11.0 (2026-08): the Driver 1½ regime-aware lunar recession history — a new term family (the staircase spline beyond 1000 Ma + the two solar angular-momentum channels: ocean leak and thermal-tide pump). The gated 0–1000 Ma era is bit-identical to v10.0.
_v12Note: v11.0 → v12.0 (2026-08): the eccentricity unification — ONE eccentricity law for Sun, Moon, cardinal points and scene, e(t) = base′·(1 + cos θ₃/2) on the System-Reset anchor (a core-law change: the H/16 eccentricity law and the two-arm scene geometry are gone; H/16 is the perihelion-direction period only). Earth measured from the scene origin (wobble circle radius 0, the wobble-centre a display marker at the Law-4 A distance); Earth-frame refit 6b–6d + 5c + the ΔT joint re-close (USNO optimum 86400.0018); the declared measured-day basis (measuredMeanSolarDayJ2000Seconds).
